thread:
Priya: Heads-up: planning thread for a progressive tenant-quarantine rollout for model-v2 in EU. Goal: protect SLAs for enterprise while exercising broader exposure to catch regressions. Outline: risk-score cohorts, regional small-batch warmup, tenant-quarantine policy, and an emergency degrade path to model-v1-compatible.
Noah: Proposal: compute a tenant risk score (1-5) from recent error history, traffic volatility, and payment tier. Start with risk <=2 tenants in phase-1 (10% of traffic), phase-2 add risk<=3 up to 40%, then open to all non-enterprise after 48h of green signals.
Layla: Important: enterprise contracts must not be auto-swapped. Add an opt-out allowlist and a soft-guard that routes enterprise traffic to v1 unless explicitly opted-in. Also expose a per-tenant "quarantine" state in Console.
Ravi: Rollback and degrade gates: automated rollback if rolling_error_rate >0.6% for 5m OR median latency delta >1.5x baseline for 10m. If triggered, switch quarantined tenants to compat-model-v1 and open circuit for 45m. Log to rollout-audit and notify #incidents.
Priya: Quarantine semantics: when a tenant trips quality checks, mark them to "quarantine" and route to compat-model-v1 until manual review. Quarantine should be reversible after a successful synthetic re-validation. Keep quarantine history for 30d.
Noah: Sampling & canary selection: mix of regional buckets (eu-west-1, eu-central-1) + low-risk tenant cohorts. Use deterministic slice header X-RW-Slice: q<n> so QA can replay. Avoid pure random because we need reproducible failures per tenant.
Layla: Metrics to watch: per-tenant error_rate, p50/p95 latencies, returned token_count, token_cost, embedding cosine drift, and business KPIs where available. Add a delta-alert for rerank changes >0.15 average on the sampled eval set.
Ravi: Circuit-breaker behavior: after an automated quarantine, pause auto-promote for 3h for that tenant and require manual approve to re-enable. For region-wide rollback, circuit remains open for 1h and auto-promote disabled for 4h.
Priya: Feature flag design: flag_id "eu_model_v2_quarantine" with fields: rollout_mode (cohort|pct|header), rollout_value, allowlist, denylist, quarantine_ttl, shadow_pct. Console should show per-tenant state and reason for quarantine.
Noah: Shadowing: run async shadow for 5% of overall requests during phase-1 for 24h. Shadow telemetry will be used to compute embedding drift and rerank differences only. Cost estimate from infra: ~+8% GPU hours that day.
Layla: QA plan: QA-Bot will run a 100-prompt synthetics job against tenants in phase-1 every 4 hours and publish a summary to rollout-thread. If QA finds regressions, we'll quarantine the tenant.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to write RFC with tenant risk buckets and exact thresholds (due tomorrow noon). 2) Noah to supply tenant-risk list + sampling script. 3) Ravi to implement quarantine automation, audit logging, and circuit timers. 4) Layla to add console flags and per-tenant quarantine UI. 5) OpsBot to schedule a 30m runbook dry-run post-RFC.
OpsBot: job-101234 queued: creating quarantine flag "eu_model_v2_quarantine" mode=cohort value=10%.
Priya: If no objections by EOD I'll post RFC and tag SRE/legal for enterprise SLA review. :eyes:
